exposure: Implementation of a hospital guideline based on ACOG's 2010 VBAC guideline
clinical practice changes based upon ACOG's 2010 VBAC guideline
outcome: Composite maternal morbidity (uterine rupture or dehiscence, hysterectomy, transfusion, thromboembolism, operative/delivery injury, chorioamnionitis/endometritis, shoulder dystocia, death)
cohort: Women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Adoption of ACOG's TOLAC practice changes can increase VBAC rates without increasing maternal-neonatal morbidity from TOLAC.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in maternal-neonatal outcomes or VBAC success rates before and after the implementation of ACOG's 2010 VBAC guideline, which included changes to clinical practice around trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
